name: Éves kedvezményes küszöb

notes: Canonical threshold; H heating season is separately allocated.

notes: Proration is daily and meter-specific.

name: A1 kedvezményes végső bruttó ár

notes: Current snapshot; final component bridge is documented separately.

name: A1 küszöb feletti végső bruttó ár
definition: Kedvezményes mennyiség feletti lakossági piaci final gross ár
notes: Not a wholesale price.

name: H idény
definition: Az október 15. és április 15. közötti H kedvezményes időszak
notes: Inclusive boundary in the canonical engine.

name: H általános minimum szezonális fűtési tényező
definition: General H seasonal-factor threshold, subject to the separately source-qualified statutory grandfather route
notes: General minimum 3.4 under §5(4). Separate §10(3) grandfather minimum 3 with exact source wording 2020. január 1-ig. No automatic commissioning-date predicate or actual device eligibility; see dated topology reference.

name: H idénybeli végső bruttó ár
definition: Elosztói területenkénti H heating-season final gross
notes: H tariff is not a general household/battery tariff.

name: H akkumulátor-interfész összefoglaló státusza
definition: Compatibility umbrella; four separate H charge, discharge, export and VPP control gates; never an implicit YES
notes: Non-canonical aggregate; never use as an implicit YES. V1-055 corrects the historical citation using the 2026-10-03 source reference; original snapshot date is not legal commencement.

name: H export összefoglaló státusza
definition: Compatibility umbrella retained for existing consumers; canonical export gate is H_TARIFF_EXPORT_ALLOWED below
notes: Non-canonical aggregate; HMKE/export permission remains topology- and DSO-specific.

name: H_TARIFF_BATTERY_CHARGE_ALLOWED
definition: Independent legal and metering gate for charging a battery from a H-tariff circuit; value is YES/NO/Q only
notes: Effective/applicability snapshot 2026-08-24; H-only dedicated circuit is evidenced for eligible heat-pump/direct auxiliaries, normal/A1-only battery is outside H, H-side battery and hybrid/common-bus authority is not explicit; fail closed Q. V1-055 corrects the historical citation using the 2026-10-03 source reference; original snapshot date is not legal commencement.

name: H_TARIFF_BATTERY_DISCHARGE_ALLOWED
definition: Independent legal and metering gate for a battery discharging into or through a H-tariff circuit; value is YES/NO/Q only
notes: Effective/applicability snapshot 2026-08-24; physical discharge capability is not legal permission, cross-meter energy flow and H-side/hybrid topology are not explicitly authorized; fail closed Q. V1-055 corrects the historical citation using the 2026-10-03 source reference; original snapshot date is not legal commencement.

name: H_TARIFF_EXPORT_ALLOWED
definition: Independent legal and metering gate for export from a H-tariff circuit or H-charged battery; value is YES/NO/Q only
notes: Effective/applicability snapshot 2026-08-24; HMKE export is POD/DSO-specific and H-side or H-charged battery export is not explicitly authorized; fail closed Q. V1-055 corrects the historical citation using the 2026-10-03 source reference; original snapshot date is not legal commencement.
